name: Waterman's Beach Lobster
closed_reason: Closed for good on Sept. 4, 2016 (Press Herald, Aug. 12, 2016). Wikipedia describes it in the past tense; the family later turned the building into Waterman's Beach Brewery. Street address not confirmed.

closed_reason: Closed in March 2020 (COVID); in October 2022 owners Big Tree Hospitality said it will not reopen in its previous form as a fine-dining restaurant. Big Tree's 2026 site lists only Eventide Oyster Co., The Honey Paw and Eventide Fenway as its restaurants. Evans sold Hugo's to Big Tree's founders in 2012; the award stays with Hugo's (not Duckfat).
